biggest_catch: UserTesting's official pages confirm 14-day PayPal payments but publish no current worker pay figures - official policy says payment 'varies based on test type, duration, and customer demand' and each test shows its own amount.
catches: No official current pay figures: payment varies per test and is only shown inside your dashboard.
You must pass an unpaid practice test before any paid tests are available.
Payment arrives 14 days after each completed test (PayPal) - not fast cash.
Test availability depends on your demographics and profile - volume is unpredictable.
Customers can request refunds for unsatisfactory tests, though the Quality Team decides.
